diagnosis_verdict: B and C recover the directly measured tv_hat SD to within 10% (approximately 1.0x), so the diagnosis supports neither a wrong denominator nor an absent between-block term. The large block-level spread is not evidence that B/C omitted a variance component; Arm D must not be run.

formula_reconciliation.armB_variance: K/(K-1) * sum((cluster - mean(cluster))^2), summed over A and B laws

notes: mean_between is the outer-replicate mean of sample var(c_k, ddof=1); mean_within is the outer and block mean of an unbiased sample variance over 32 conditional multinomial redraws given each captured theta. K=938 includes the final 32-flow residual block, and c_k uses the requested /B scaling. Arm B/C implied SDs remove their critical values and use the formulas already in the Track 5 runner. The observed_factor is empirical_sd divided by the mean of the B/C implied SDs; it is the relevant wrong-denominator comparison. The empirical_to_iid_radius_factor is reported separately because the i.i.d. value is a finite-alphabet confidence radius, not a Gaussian SD.
prediction_for_armD_before_run: Arm D prediction before run: radius larger than the i.i.d. radius, with CP95 coverage nearer nominal 0.975 than Arm A's 0.9940; a CP interval excluding nominal from either side is a falsifier.
